title: TemporalHypergraphExtraction
description: Schema for extracting N-ary hyperedges with temporal boundaries from raw text (docs/MyUnderstanding/Schema_SystemPrompts.txt).

entities.description: List of unique atomic entities identified in the text.

id.description: Normalized identifier using format category:snake_case_name (e.g., person:sam_altman, org:openai).

aliases.description: Alternative names or acronyms mentioned in text.

hyperedges.description: List of N-ary relationships (hyperedges) binding 2 or more entities into a single event context.

event_type.description: High-level categorization (e.g., EXECUTIVE_ROLE, INVESTMENT, ACQUISITION, PRODUCT_LAUNCH, LEGAL_ACTION).

summary.description: One-sentence factual description of the N-ary interaction.

participants.description: All N entities participating in this hyperedge.

entity_id.description: Must match an ID from the entities array.

role.description: Functional role within this specific event (e.g., ACQUIRER, TARGET_COMPANY, INVESTOR, REGULATORY_BODY).

temporal_boundary.description: Temporal interval governing the validity of this hyperedge.

valid_from.description: ISO-8601 timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) indicating when the hyperedge became true, or null if unknown.

valid_to.description: ISO-8601 timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) indicating when the hyperedge ended/expired, or null if ongoing/unknown.

is_ongoing.description: True if the state remains active relative to the text's timeline.

raw_temporal_expression.description: Verbatim temporal string extracted from text (e.g., 'Q3 2023', 'last Tuesday', 'from 2018 to 2021').

confidence_score.description: Extraction confidence in [0, 1] based on textual explicit placement.
